 EL PASO, Texas (KFOX14/CBS4) — A 34-year-old man died after he reportedly rolled over his car while trying to run from police in West El Paso. 
 According to the El Paso Police Department, Marcos Mendoza fled from police who were trying to pull him over while he was driving down Mesa Street, going towards Glory Road.
 While fleeing, Mendoza then allegedly turned onto Glory Road, hit a curb, and climbed onto I-10, going west, where he lost control, crashed into a guardrail and rolled over near the Executive exit. 
 Mendoza was taken to a local hospital, where police said he died from his injuries.
 According to EPPD statistics, this is the 60th traffic death of the year, compared to 57 at this time in 2025.
 Video showing what looks like the chase was shared on the popular social media account @therealfitfamelpaso.
